title: fix: clean up responsive agent cards
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps long agent and base-model IDs contained and truncated
- Gives mobile cards a fixed three-row header with consistent spacing
- Shows the generation estimate as a one-line third row on mobile
- Moves the agent-pricing explanation into the standard footer legend and keeps it visible across all model views
- Verifies 320px–1440px layouts; passes Biome, TypeScript, and the frontend production build

gist.headline: Cards learned to wrap
gist.blurb: The model garden got a small pruning. Even the longest agent IDs now stay politely inside their pots, including on the tiniest screens.
gist.summary: Fixed responsive agent model cards so long agent and base-model IDs truncate cleanly, mobile headers keep a fixed three-row layout, generation estimates occupy a one-line third row, and agent-pricing help remains visible in the shared footer legend.
gist.impact: People browsing models from 320px mobile screens through desktop will see stable card spacing, readable pricing context, and no escaped model-name vines.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden where oversized label vines are neatly trimmed to fit small seed packets, representing long agent and base-model IDs being contained. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener visor, tends a three-tier mobile card planter beside a glowing retro phone; a clear footer sign explains agent pricing while flowers and code-plants fill the scene.
